user_saw: When a Telegram user replied to a photo by resending it, the agent received two copies of the same image.
summary: The Telegram pipeline now uses file_unique_id to skip reply attachments that duplicate successfully downloaded current attachments.
reasoning: The July 1 shallow boundary already showed the ordinary reply path resolving reply media separately from current attachments and passing both into the turn without comparing source IDs. The September change added external-reply hydration, and the October refactor moved hydration inline. The offline history stopped at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify whether ordinary replies had duplicated images since the feature was introduced or an earlier change broke deduplication.
